posts.text: It’s a lovely day here at The Sandbach Community Football Centre where we host @EccleshallFC in @nwcfl Division One South, get yourself down for what promises to be a cracking game. Team sheet coming soon…….

3RD V 4TH as the Ramblers look to capitalise on their home form and continue the 5 game unbeaten run. Whilst Eccleshall will want to cause an upset and continue their 4 game winning streak.   Should be a cracker of a game. https://t.co/gQU2LcEDkX
Thank you @CheadleNomads for the usual good hospitality 👏🏻
We hear from the Dec and JKD after the game. https://t.co/PLHAJJLSGX
FT 3-3 feels like a loss conceding so late but credit nomads for not giving up

A free kick delivered by AJ for nomads floats in finds a team mate who heads across goal and it’s nodded in at close range 

3-3 

Seconds to play
The Subs from Sandbach have completely changed this game
Chance for Fowles but AJ makes it tough for him and Fowles can’t quite get the shot around the keeper.

2-3 as Foley grabs a brace after Hatton works hard to win the ball and places a killer ball through for Foley to slot in beyond the closing keeper. 

77’ gone https://t.co/VVr1enVhGD
Good impact from Fowles who finds himself involved in the game with great movement

Sub
Barry off
Fowles on
The two Sandbach subs have changed the dynamic and shape with the Ramblers now gaining some traction in midfield that was missing in the first half.
2-2 and it is Top Scoring O’Connell once again with a close range diving header in the 63rd minute https://t.co/DnrtiyZqVK

Sub
Pollard and Williams off
O’Connell and K Nolan on
Back underway with work to do for the Ramblers to get back into this game.

Good goal from Nomads on 28’ to retake the lead a floating accurate shot narrowly off the top bin hits the post and goes in. Good strike. 

2-1
26’ gone and it’s 1-1 great goal from Foley as he turns twice and shots with accuracy from the angle to make the net bulge. https://t.co/AAQOGtiXyt
1-0 on 18’ as a ball high and deep over the box is shinned in with a looping goal.  Need to pick up the free players.
Very soft card that however Tats goes in the book on the 9th minute https://t.co/1T1O0tlVMP
Tatters starting today marked his 200th appearance for Sandbach. Outstanding effort and commitment to the club 🙌🏻
5’ gone and both sides have had a decent chance but not capitalised.
Sandbach are up for this game today and line up as follows https://t.co/PgWfOzyqs4

90 - In to 6 minutes added time 

🔴🔴 5-2 🔵🔵

75 - Goal Alsager

11 gets his 2nd of the game with a well taken finish from inside the penalty area 

🔴🔴 5-2 🔵🔵

72 - JONNNEESSS!!!!

Sibanda gets down the right, cuts the ball back for Jones who arrives in the box and slots the ball past the keeper! 

🔴🔴 5-1 🔵🔵 https://t.co/fB05VDk8ex

66 - Parker should have his hattrick

Jones gets down the right and squares for Parker who blazes his shot over the bar. 

That’s his last action of the game as he is replaced by Sibanda 

🔴🔴 4-1 🔵🔵

63 - Double sub for Town 

Draper and Perry are on for Lynch and Taylor

🔴🔴 4-1 🔵🔵

58 - Double sub for Town

Jones and Sherwood on for Mazurkiewicz and Wilson

🔴🔴 4-1 🔵🔵

52 - PARRRKKKEERRR!!!

Great work by Pat to spin his man down the right, he crosses and Parker is on hand to tap in from close range!

🔴🔴 4-1 🔵🔵 https://t.co/7q99QLt8ee

51 - Good save from the Alsager keeper 

Clarkson with a powerful strike from the edge of the area. The keeper is down well to save!

🔴🔴 3-1 🔵🔵

Second half is underway! 

🔴🔴 3-1 🔵🔵
Ahead at the break! https://t.co/qIio8iL4Cb

45+1 - Another great chance

Lynch with a cross is headed just wide by Parker 

🔴🔴 3-1 🔵🔵

40 - Greer goes close

Wilson with a great ball into the box. Eshan gets above his man and heads just wide 

🔴🔴 3-1 🔵🔵

33 - LYNNNCCCHHH!!!

If he meant that it’s goal of the season. I’m going to say an over hit cross lobs the keeper and finds the top corner!

🔴🔴 3-1 🔵🔵 https://t.co/28GjxAYSRU

30 - Goal Alsager 

Number 11 with a powerful strike from a tight angle. 

🔴🔴 2-1 🔵🔵

28 - WILLLDDDIIINNNGG!!!

Good feet from Lynch to work the ball across the pitch, finds Pat on the right who whips his cross across the 6 yard box, and Wildling applies a cute flick to the the ball past the keeper and into the net! 

🔴🔴 2-0 🔵🔵 https://t.co/tOZKzxhtIt

20 - It should be 2

Some great play on the edge of the Alsager box, the ball falls to Lynch 6 yards out and he somehow puts his shot wide. 

🔴🔴 1-0 🔵🔵

17 - Alsager nearly equalise. 

A freekick is floated into the box. An Alsager player rises highest and heads just wide 

🔴🔴 1-0 🔵🔵

16 - PARRRRKKKEEERR!!!

Great flick by Greer to put Parker in 1-on-1 with the keeper and he smashes the ball into the net! 

🔴🔴 1-0 🔵🔵 https://t.co/IUoHz0TCIg
